# FLX-7140: a forecast item has too few replicates with a value for its interval

**Family:** calibration (the 7000 band)

A forecast item's value in one replicate is the share of the subjects of its segment in its arm whose first reaction succeeded, and a replicate with no such subject gives none. The interval runs from the value of rank a to the value of rank count + 1 - a, with a the largest whole number not above count (1 - c) / 2, so it needs at least one rank on each side. Fewer values than that cannot give the interval at the confidence c. Nothing is registered for any item. Make the segment or the arm larger, or the sweep longer.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-7140
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
